title: Stale docstring: _upstream_addr_for_key still lists authenticated_schc_dio.json as legacy-consumer
description: From r1ur codereview pass 2. python/tests/test_protocol_vector_security.py:58-62 — the _upstream_addr_for_key docstring says authenticated_schc_dio.json is 'still on the rejected SHA-512 profile' and keeps legacy _addr_for_key, but r1ur migrated that corpus and flipped its binding check. After the fix, root_authorization.json is the only remaining legacy consumer. One-line docstring update.
